name: UI：优质模板库-洗图状态筛选验证
description: 验证优质模板库洗图状态筛选：Radio/Tab切换→列表更新→数据一致性

steps.expression: (() => { const radios = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio], input[type=radio], .ant-radio-button-wrapper, [class*=washStatus], [class*=wash]')).map(el => ({ text: el.textContent?.trim()?.substring(0, 20) || '', tag: el.tagName, checked: el.checked || el.classList?.contains('ant-radio-button-wrapper-checked') })); const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); return { radios, tabs }; })()
steps.description: 查找洗图状态筛选元素

steps.expression: (() => { const options = document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio], .ant-radio-button-wrapper, [class*=washStatus]'); if(options.length > 1) { options[1].click(); return 'clicked option 2'; } return 'no options'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在洗图状态数据。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 洗图状态筛选可能为Radio Group或Tab，选项含：全部/已洗图/未洗图/洗图中。
riskPoints: 洗图状态选项文案需实际确认
